summary: @servicetitan/install preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun standalone runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js at the package root (execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])). math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line CommonJS blob obfuscated with a rotated hex-value string array (WV8StW shuffler) and a runtime decoder (hc1jfK9); it is not referenced by dist/index.js, bin/index.js, or src/. The package's advertised purpose is a wrapper around npm install that configures access to private packages, which does not require an alternate language runtime or an obfuscated sibling payload. Execution is automatic on any npm install of this package: an alternate runtime (Bun) is fetched at install time specifically to run a heavily obfuscated blob whose behavior cannot be statically verified and is unrelated to the stated functionality. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape — install-time fetch of a runtime plus execution of shipped opaque code — and the obfuscation is chosen to defeat static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
